positions.name: PantryShelfFillLineMarking
positions.frame: How is the pantry's restock threshold made checkable at the shelf, so that knowing when to restock takes a look rather than a count?
positions.why: Dario's statement carries its own frame. The existing pantry positions ask what fill level triggers a restock, and why the fastest-depleting shelves differ. This one asks how staff tell that a shelf has reached its threshold, answered with a marked fill line and a visual glance in place of counting. It is dated 2026-10-09, before the 2026-10-15 oats-and-rice exception, so a mark 'at a third' on every shelf sits in tension with oats and rice later restocking at half. The tension is left open, since the frame holds both. The statement is a plain assertion of settled practice and bears on the operating-rhythms narrative, which is about recurring operations running by explicit rules.
